items.name: marketing-hero-sections-product-carousel-hero

items.description: A hero with a swipeable product carousel beside a headline and CTA. Showcases a range of items or plans at the top of an ecommerce landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-progress-tracker-hero
items.title: Progress Tracker Hero
items.description: A hero with a step progress tracker next to a headline and CTA. Use it to show a setup flow or journey at the top of an onboarding landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-search-bar
items.title: Search Bar
items.description: A hero centered on a prominent search bar below a headline and subtext. Ideal for directories, docs, marketplaces, and content heavy landing pages.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-simple-centred
items.title: Simple Centred
items.description: A clean centered hero with a headline, short subtext, and a single CTA. A minimal, fast loading opener that suits almost any landing page or product.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-social-proof-hero
items.title: Social Proof Hero
items.description: A hero pairing a headline and CTA with logos, ratings, and user counts. Leads with credibility to reassure visitors at the top of a landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-split-content-hero
items.title: Split Content Hero
items.description: A hero with a two column split, text and CTA on one side, content on the other. A flexible opener that balances your message and a visual cleanly.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-split-image-hero
items.title: Split Image Hero
items.description: A hero split into a text column and a full height product image. A direct, balanced opener that pairs your pitch with a visual on a landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-split-with-video
items.title: Split With Video
items.description: A hero split between a headline with CTA and an embedded product video. Use it to show your product in motion at the top of a landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-testimonial-carousel
items.title: Testimonial Carousel
items.description: A hero with a rotating carousel of customer testimonials and a CTA. Opens a landing page with real quotes to build trust before the pitch lands.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-trust-indicators
items.title: Trust Indicators
items.description: A hero leading with security badges, certifications, and partner logos. Reassures cautious buyers at the top of a landing or enterprise sales page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-video-background-hero
items.title: Video Background Hero
items.description: A hero with a looping video filling the background behind a headline and CTA. Sets an immersive, cinematic tone at the top of a landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-3d-mockup
items.title: With 3D Mockup
items.description: A hero featuring a rotating 3D device mockup beside a headline and CTA. Presents your app or product with depth on a modern landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-api-preview
items.title: With API Preview
items.description: A hero pairing a headline and CTA with a live API request and response preview. Built for developer tools and platforms aimed at technical buyers.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-app-showcase
items.title: With App Showcase
items.description: A hero showcasing app screens in a layered layout next to a headline and CTA. Use it to highlight the interface on a software product landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-bento-grid
items.title: With Bento Grid
items.description: A hero with a bento grid of feature tiles below a headline and CTA. Summarizes several capabilities at a glance on a modern SaaS landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-code-preview
items.title: With Code Preview
items.description: A hero pairing a headline and CTA with a syntax highlighted code snippet. Speaks directly to developers at the top of a tool or library landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-content-tabs
items.title: With Content Tabs
items.description: A hero with tabbed panels that swap content beneath a headline and CTA. Use it to present several use cases or features in one compact area.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-dashboard
items.title: With Dashboard
items.description: A hero placing a product dashboard screenshot next to a headline and CTA. Shows your interface and data at the top of a SaaS or analytics page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-email-input
items.title: With Email Input
items.description: A hero centered on an inline email capture form below a headline and subtext. Ideal for waitlists, newsletters, and early access landing pages.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-feature-cards
items.title: With Feature Cards
items.description: A hero with a row of feature cards beneath a headline and CTA. Breaks your key benefits into scannable tiles at the top of a landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-feature-timeline
items.title: With Feature Timeline
items.description: A hero with a feature timeline beside a headline and CTA. Walks visitors through a workflow or roadmap at the top of a product landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-integration-showcase
items.title: With Integration Showcase
items.description: A hero showing a grid of integration logos beside a headline and CTA. Highlights the tools your product connects to on a platform landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-product-screenshots
items.title: With Product Screenshots
items.description: A hero with framed product screenshots next to a headline and CTA. Shows the real interface at the top of a software or SaaS landing page.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-team-grid
items.title: With Team Grid
items.description: A hero pairing a headline and CTA with a grid of team member photos. Adds a human face to about, agency, and company landing pages from the start.

items.name: marketing-hero-sections-with-terminal
items.title: With Terminal
items.description: A hero pairing a headline and CTA with an animated terminal window. Speaks to developers and shows install or usage commands on a tool landing page.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-2-cols-grid
items.title: 2 Cols Grid
items.description: A two column grid pairing each icon with a heading and short paragraph. Lays out a handful of product features in a clean, balanced reading layout.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-animated-icon-grid
items.title: Animated Icon Grid
items.description: A grid of feature icons that animate into view on scroll. Adds motion to a list of capabilities so each benefit catches the eye as users read down.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-centred-description-with-icon-blocks
items.title: Centred Description With Icon Blocks
items.description: A centred intro paragraph above a row of icon blocks. Frames a section theme, then lists supporting features in tidy, evenly spaced columns.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-circle-icons-centre-aligned
items.title: Circle Icons Centre Aligned
items.description: Centre aligned icons set in soft circles, each with a title and caption. A friendly way to present three or four core benefits on a landing page.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-compact-metric-list
items.title: Compact Metric List
items.description: A tight vertical list pairing icons with numbers and labels. Shows key metrics in a small footprint, ideal for sidebars or dense feature pages.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-description-on-left-icon-blocks-on-right
items.title: Description On Left Icon Blocks On Right
items.description: A split layout with a section heading and copy on the left and stacked icon blocks on the right. Pairs a narrative pitch with scannable feature points.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-expandable-icon-cards
items.title: Expandable Icon Cards
items.description: Icon cards that expand on click to reveal more detail. Keeps the section compact while letting curious visitors dig into any feature they choose.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-feature-icon-tabs
items.title: Feature Icon Tabs
items.description: Icon tabs that switch between feature panels in place. Lets visitors explore several capabilities without scrolling, one focused view at a time.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-horizontal-scrolling-icons
items.title: Horizontal Scrolling Icons
items.description: A horizontal strip of icon cards users swipe or scroll through. Fits many features in limited height and reads naturally on mobile screens.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-icon-feature-carousel
items.title: Icon Feature Carousel
items.description: A carousel rotating through icon features one slide at a time. Highlights a long list of capabilities without crowding the page or overwhelming readers.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-icon-stats-grid
items.title: Icon Stats Grid
items.description: A grid of stat cards pairing an icon with a bold number and label. Surfaces growth figures and key results to build trust on a marketing page.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-icon-tabs-categories
items.title: Icon Tabs Categories
items.description: Category tabs marked with icons that filter the features shown below. Helps visitors jump straight to the feature set that matches their needs.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-icon-timeline
items.title: Icon Timeline
items.description: A vertical timeline with an icon at each step. Walks visitors through a process or product journey in clear order, one milestone after another.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-icons-with-tooltips
items.title: Icons With Tooltips
items.description: A row of icons that reveal a short tooltip on hover. Packs many features into a small space while keeping extra detail one cursor away.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-interactive-icon-showcase
items.title: Interactive Icon Showcase
items.description: An interactive panel where hovering an icon updates the description beside it. Invites visitors to explore features at their own pace and stay engaged.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-metric-cards
items.title: Metric Cards
items.description: A set of cards pairing an icon with a headline metric and caption. Presents results, usage, or savings in confident, easy to scan tiles.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-minimal-stats-tiles
items.title: Minimal Stats Tiles
items.description: Clean tiles showing an icon, a number, and a short label. A spare way to display a few key stats without distracting from the surrounding copy.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-radial-icon-layout
items.title: Radial Icon Layout
items.description: Icons arranged in a circular, radial pattern around a central label. A distinctive way to show how features connect to one core product idea.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-solid-icon-with-hover-effect
items.title: Solid Icon With Hover Effect
items.description: Solid filled icons that shift colour or lift on hover. Adds tactile feedback to a feature grid so the section feels responsive as visitors browse.

items.name: marketing-icon-sections-stacked-cards
items.title: Stacked Cards
items.description: Vertically stacked icon cards, each with a title and short blurb. Reads top to bottom on any screen and keeps a long feature list easy to follow.

items.name: marketing-integrations-api-preview
items.title: API Preview
items.description: A code sample panel beside copy that explains your API. Drop it on a developer page to show how integrations connect in only a few short lines.

items.name: marketing-integrations-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A scrolling row of partner and app logos that loops as visitors watch. Place it under a hero to prove your product fits neatly into an existing stack.

items.name: marketing-integrations-category-tabs
items.title: Category Tabs
items.description: Tabs that sort connected apps by type, so visitors filter integrations to find the one they use. Ideal for a busy marketplace or directory page.

items.name: marketing-integrations-featured-showcase
items.title: Featured Showcase
items.description: A large card spotlighting one key integration with its logo, summary, and a link. Use it to highlight a flagship partner above the full list.

items.name: marketing-integrations-simple-grid
items.title: Simple Grid
items.description: A clean grid of integration logos in even rows and columns. Use it on a connections page to display the apps and services your product supports.

items.name: marketing-masonry-sections-cards-on-images
items.title: Cards On Images
items.description: A masonry grid of cards layered over images, each with a heading and short text. Showcases a gallery, portfolio, or product collection on a landing page.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-calculator
items.title: Calculator
items.description: A pricing calculator with sliders and inputs that estimate cost from usage. Use it when plans scale by seats, requests, or volume so buyers see real numbers.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: A row of pricing cards listing plan names, prices, and features with a clear call to action. Drop it on a pricing page to compare tiers at a glance.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-custom-builder
items.title: Custom Builder
items.description: A plan builder where buyers pick features and quantities to assemble a quote. Use it for modular products where every customer needs a different mix.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-enterprise
items.title: Enterprise
items.description: A pricing layout pairing standard tiers with a contact sales panel for large accounts. Use it when bigger deals need custom quotes and a human conversation.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: A pricing table mapping every feature to each plan across rows and columns. Use it when buyers want to confirm exactly what each tier includes before paying.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-horizontal
items.title: Horizontal
items.description: A wide pricing row that lays plans side by side in a single band. Fits narrow page slots and pages where you want plans visible without much scrolling.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-interactive
items.title: Interactive
items.description: A pricing section that updates prices and highlights as buyers select options. Use it when choices like seats or add ons should reflect cost instantly.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-minimalist
items.title: Minimalist
items.description: A pared back pricing layout with generous spacing, plain type, and one clear price. Use it when a single plan or clean brand needs no visual clutter.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-modern
items.title: Modern
items.description: A contemporary pricing section with bold cards, soft shadows, and accent gradients. Use it to give a polished, current feel to a product or SaaS page.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-seasonal
items.title: Seasonal
items.description: A pricing section with promotional banners and limited time discounts on each plan. Use it for holiday sales, launches, and campaigns that push urgency.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-simple
items.title: Simple
items.description: A clean pricing section showing a few plans with price, features, and a button each. Use it when you want fast comprehension without extra decoration.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-stacked
items.title: Stacked
items.description: A pricing layout that stacks plan cards vertically for narrow columns and phones. Use it on mobile first pages or sidebars where width is limited.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: A pricing section that pairs plan cards with customer quotes and logos. Use it to add social proof right where buyers weigh price and decide to commit.

items.name: marketing-pricing-sections-toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A pricing section with a monthly and yearly switch that updates every plan price. Use it to show annual savings and let buyers pick a billing cycle fast.

items.name: marketing-stats-achievement-bars
items.title: Achievement Bars
items.description: Horizontal bars that fill to show milestones reached against a target. Drop it on a results page to visualize goals hit and progress toward each one.

items.name: marketing-stats-card-group
items.title: Card Group
items.description: A cluster of stat cards with a big number, label, and short caption in each. Use it to spotlight key metrics across a landing page in a clean grid.

items.name: marketing-stats-circular-progress
items.title: Circular Progress
items.description: Ring shaped progress dials that animate to a percentage value. Good for dashboards or landing pages that report completion rates and capacity at a glance.

items.name: marketing-stats-comparison-metrics
items.title: Comparison Metrics
items.description: Two columns of numbers placed side by side to contrast before and after results. Use it to show the lift your product delivers over the old way.

items.name: marketing-stats-comparison-stats
items.title: Comparison Stats
items.description: Paired figures with labels that weigh your offering against a baseline. Great for sales pages that need to make the gain feel concrete and credible.

items.name: marketing-stats-customer-testimonial
items.title: Customer Testimonial
items.description: A quote from a customer next to the numbers their team reached with you. Use it to pair social proof with hard results on a case study page.

items.name: marketing-stats-funnel-stats
items.title: Funnel Stats
items.description: A stepped funnel showing how many visitors move from view to signup to paid. Use it to explain conversion and where users drop off in your flow.

items.name: marketing-stats-gradient-grid
items.title: Gradient Grid
items.description: A grid of stat tiles washed in soft gradients for a vivid, modern look. Use it to display headline metrics when you want the section to feel premium.

items.name: marketing-stats-growth-timeline
items.title: Growth Timeline
items.description: A vertical timeline pairing dates with the numbers you hit at each stage. Use it to chart company momentum on an about page or investor deck.

items.name: marketing-stats-horizontal-with-dividers
items.title: Horizontal With Dividers
items.description: A single row of figures split by thin vertical dividers for a tidy summary. Use it under a hero to surface three or four headline numbers fast.

items.name: marketing-stats-impact-numbers
items.title: Impact Numbers
items.description: Oversized counters that animate upward as the section scrolls into view. Use it to make reach, users, or revenue feel bold and immediate to readers.

items.name: marketing-stats-interactive-hover
items.title: Interactive Hover
items.description: Stat cards that reveal extra detail or a chart when you hover over them. Use it when you want a number to expand into context on a feature page.

items.name: marketing-stats-metric-cards
items.title: Metric Cards
items.description: Bordered cards each holding one metric, a label, and a trend note. Use it to report KPIs in a structured layout on a homepage or product page.

items.name: marketing-stats-one-main-with-three-follow-ups
items.title: One Main With Three Follow Ups
items.description: One large headline number anchored by three smaller supporting stats. Use it to lead with your strongest figure and back it with related proof.

items.name: marketing-stats-progress-bars
items.title: Progress Bars
items.description: Labeled bars that fill to a percentage to track adoption or completion. Use it on a status page or report to show how far each goal has come.

items.name: marketing-stats-simple-3-cols
items.title: Simple 3 Cols
items.description: Three evenly spaced columns each with a number and a short label below. Use it for a clean, balanced stats strip on any marketing or about page.

items.name: marketing-stats-sparkline-stats
items.title: Sparkline Stats
items.description: Stat cards that pair a current value with a tiny inline trend chart. Use it to show a number and its recent direction together on a dashboard view.

items.name: marketing-stats-stats-with-icons
items.title: Stats With Icons
items.description: Each figure sits beside an icon that signals what the number measures. Use it to make a stats row scannable and add visual cues to every metric.

items.name: marketing-stats-timeline-stats
items.title: Timeline Stats
items.description: Key numbers plotted along a horizontal timeline of moments and dates. Use it to tell a growth story across quarters on an about or press page.

items.name: marketing-stats-trust-indicators
items.title: Trust Indicators
items.description: A band of proof points like uptime, customers, and ratings in one row. Use it near a signup form to reassure visitors and lift their confidence.

items.name: marketing-subscribe-benefits-list
items.title: Benefits List
items.description: A subscribe form paired with a bulleted list of benefits and an email field. Tells visitors what they get before they sign up to your newsletter.

items.name: marketing-subscribe-incentive-center-aligned
items.title: Incentive Center Aligned
items.description: A centered signup block that offers a clear incentive above the email field. Use it to reward visitors who join your list with a discount or guide.

items.name: marketing-subscribe-input-style

items.name: marketing-subscribe-newsletter-preview
items.title: Newsletter Preview
items.description: A signup block showing a small preview of the newsletter content beside the email field. Sets reader expectations before they subscribe to it.

items.name: marketing-subscribe-simple-center-aligned
items.title: Simple Center Aligned
items.description: A clean centered newsletter signup with a heading, short text, and email field. The reliable default for landing pages and blog footers here.

items.name: marketing-subscribe-simple-right-aligned
items.title: Simple Right Aligned

items.name: marketing-subscribe-social-proof-center
items.title: Social Proof Center
items.description: A centered subscribe form topped with subscriber counts or avatars as social proof. Use it when trust nudges visitors to join your mailing list.

items.name: marketing-subscribe-split-layout
items.title: Split Layout
items.description: A two column subscribe block pairing an image or copy on one side with the email form on the other. Adds visual interest to a signup section.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-alternating-sections
items.title: Alternating Sections

items.name: marketing-team-sections-masonry-grid
items.title: Masonry Grid

items.name: marketing-team-sections-simple-cards
items.title: Simple Cards
items.description: A clean grid of team member cards, each with a photo, name, and role. The fast, tidy way to introduce a small team on an about or company page.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-with-contact
items.title: With Contact
items.description: Team cards that pair each photo and role with an email or phone link. Lets visitors reach the right person directly from your about or contact page.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-with-filters
items.title: With Filters
items.description: A team directory with category filters that sort members by department or location. Helps visitors find the right person inside a large company.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-with-hover-cards
items.title: With Hover Cards
items.description: A team grid where each photo reveals a short bio and social links on hover. Keeps the layout clean while extra detail stays one mouse move away.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-with-large-images
items.title: With Large Images
items.description: Team profiles built around big, full bleed portraits with name and role. Puts faces front and center for a bold, personal about page that feels human.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-with-skill-badges
items.title: With Skill Badges
items.description: Team cards that list each member with badges for their skills and tools. Great for agencies and studios that want to show real expertise at a glance.

items.name: marketing-team-sections-with-testimonials
items.title: With Testimonials
items.description: Team profiles paired with short quotes from each member or their clients. Adds a human voice and social proof to the about page of any company.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-base
items.title: Base
items.description: A clean testimonial section with a customer quote, name, role, and avatar. Drop it onto any landing page to add a trusted voice with little effort.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-big-image
items.title: Big Image
items.description: A testimonial paired with a large customer photo beside the quote. Use it when you want a single voice to carry weight and feel personal and real.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: A grid of testimonial cards, each holding a quote, avatar, name, and title. Show several happy customers at once to build trust across your page.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-cards-with-stats
items.title: Cards With Stats
items.description: Testimonial cards joined by a row of headline metrics like users and revenue. Pair real quotes with hard numbers to prove your product delivers.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-customer-story-showcase
items.title: Customer Story Showcase
items.description: A featured customer story with a detailed quote, company logo, and result. Use it as social proof when one account speaks to your ideal buyer.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-mini-with-dividers-in-grid
items.title: Mini With Dividers In Grid
items.description: Compact testimonials arranged in a grid with thin dividers between them. Fit many short quotes into a tidy space without crowding the layout.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-short-review-with-logo-and-stars
items.title: Short Review With Logo And Stars
items.description: A brief review with a star rating and a company logo for instant credibility. Place it near a pricing table to reassure buyers before they commit.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-simple-center-aligned-with-logo
items.title: Simple Center Aligned With Logo
items.description: A single centered quote topped with a company logo and the author below. Keep focus on one strong endorsement on a calm, uncluttered section.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-small-image
items.title: Small Image
items.description: A testimonial with a small rounded avatar set beside a concise quote and name. A friendly, lightweight option for sidebars or quieter page spots.

items.name: marketing-testimonials-with-stats
items.title: With Stats
items.description: A testimonial section blended with key metrics such as customers served and ratings. Combine a quote with proof points to back your claims with data.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-company-intro-hero

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-founding-story-split

items.description: A founding story split: mono tag and large heading on the left lane, two measured prose paragraphs on the right.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-hiring-banner-strip

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-leadership-avatar-grid

items.description: A five up leadership grid of tile cards with large illustrated avatars, names, and roles under an asymmetric header.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-leadership-team
items.title: Leadership Team
items.description: A two part header with a credibility wordmark strip above a five up row of leadership portraits, each with a name and role, to put real faces behind the product.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-meet-the-team

items.description: A swipeable carousel of team profile cards with names, roles, and portraits, each opening a short bio in a dialog.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-numbered-value-cards

items.description: Three numbered value cards: mono index, bold principle, and a two line explanation on gradient panels.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-our-purpose

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-story-timeline
items.title: Story Timeline
items.description: A vertical 'Our story' timeline of company milestones, alternating a photo with the year and a short paragraph beside a center rail, with the most recent year highlighted.

items.name: modern-saas-about-sections-team-stats-interlude

items.description: A quiet company facts interlude: two large proof stats split by a hairline, followed by a single transitional statement line about the team.

items.name: modern-saas-auth-pages-depth-login

items.name: modern-saas-auth-pages-depth-signup

items.description: A split signup screen: form half with SSO pills and fields, proof half with a customer quote and social proof row.

items.name: modern-saas-blog-sections-article-card-grid

items.name: modern-saas-blog-sections-article-prose-page

items.name: modern-saas-blog-sections-card-carousel

items.description: A swipeable carousel of blog post cards, each pairing a cover image with a category, date, two line title, and read time.

items.name: modern-saas-blog-sections-category-post-list

items.description: A blog category page: breadcrumb, left aligned heading with mono post count, category filter pills, a column of quiet list rows, and an honest load more pill.

items.name: modern-saas-blog-sections-featured-post-grid

items.name: modern-saas-blog-sections-filterable-post-grid

items.description: A blog post grid with working category filter pills over two rows of text first post cards with mono meta lanes and illustrated avatar bylines.
